card.name: Read the instructions carefully
card.fires_on: Words in a 'read the instructions/patient information carefully before using' sentence, mainly 'carefully', 'before', 'completely', or 'all' after 'read'. Seen in label preparation and patient-information sections.

modes.label: Carefully after read
modes.description: The adverb 'carefully' or 'completely' closes a 'read the instructions' phrase.
modes.example: Read all the instructions<< carefully>> before using IZERVAY.

modes.label: Before after read-carefully
modes.description: The word 'before' follows 'read ... carefully' and leads into the first use of the product.
modes.example: Read this entire section carefully<< before>> mixing and diluting.

card.writes: It pushes toward product-manual words like install, warranty and instructions, a loose link to 'read the manual' language.
card.plain: It marks the 'read the instructions carefully before use' wording in drug labels.
